what: When a character or sticker appears, it drops from above tilted (−22° etc.), straightens and hits the ground (height/720 seconds, min 1.2s, power2.in), squashes to 1.08 wide and .92 tall for .08s on impact, then stretches back over .18s with back.out(2). Setting several with only different delays stacks them in turn

options.drop: Drop height (px, negative is up), default -420
options.speed: px falling per second — time is height/speed, default 720 (original phone 400)
options.squash: Horizontal scale when squashed (vertical is 2 − this value), default 1.08
options.area: Ancestor selector to start from once visible (the element itself if none)
options.threshold: How much must be visible to start, default .05

from.where: list.js news header bubble row (.jkv__visual) — original initJournalSubKvMotion direct values (height/720, min 1.2s, .08 power1.out → .18 back.out(2))

note: The original calculates the stacking spot on top of the supporting character (stack) — the part only falls from its own place, so the user sets the stacking spot by position
